frameIssues: Hands are clasped together in front of her waist and will animate into mirrored two-hand gestures.

summary: The candidate is convincingly Priya Mehta on every facial feature, but she should be re-posed with her hands apart and dressed in a more figure-hugging outfit that shows her hourglass shape before animation.
